73: // Description - Bulk create-or-update operation on exposed on-premise systems. This handler supports two types of reports - full and delta.
74: // This handler takes a list of fully described SCCs together with the exposed systems.
75: // It creates new application for every exposed system for which CMP isn't aware of, and updates the metadata for the ones it is.
76: // - In case of full report: If there is SCC which was not reported, all exposed systems of this SCC are marked as unreachable.
77: // - In case of delta report: If there are missing exposed systems for a particular SCC, these systems are marked as unreachable.
78: // URL          - /api/v1/notifications
79: // Query Params - reportType=[full, delta]
80: // HTTP Method  - PUT
81: // Content-Type - application/json
82: // HTTP Codes:
83: // 204 No Content:
84: // - In case of delta report: if all systems are processed successfully
85: // - In case of full report: if the request was processed
86: // 200 OK:
87: // - In case of delta report: if update/create failed for some on-premise systems
88: // 400 Bad Request:
89: // - missing or invalid required report type query parameter
90: // - failed to parse request body
91: // - validating request body failed
92: // 500 Internal Server Error:
93: // - In case internal issue occurred. Example: db communication failed
94: func (a *Handler) ServeHTTP(rw http.ResponseWriter, req *http.Request) {
95: 	ctx := req.Context()
96: 	logger := log.C(ctx)
97: 
98: 	defer func() {
99: 		if err := req.Body.Close(); err != nil {
100: 			logger.Error("Got error on closing request body", err)
101: 		}
102: 	}()
103: 
104: 	reportHandlers := map[string]reportHandlerFunc{
105: 		reportTypeFull:  a.handleFullReport,
106: 		reportTypeDelta: a.handleDeltaReport,
107: 	}
108: 
109: 	reportType := req.URL.Query().Get(reportTypeQueryParam)
110: 	reportHandler, ok := reportHandlers[reportType]
111: 	if !ok {
112: 		httputil.RespondWithError(ctx, rw, http.StatusBadRequest, httputil.Error{
113: 			Code:    http.StatusBadRequest,
114: 			Message: "missing or invalid required report type query parameter",
115: 		})
116: 		return
117: 	}
118: 
119: 	var reportData nsmodel.Report
120: 	err := json.NewDecoder(req.Body).Decode(&reportData)
121: 	if err != nil {
122: 		logger.Warnf("Got error on decoding Request Body: %v\n", err)
123: 		httputil.RespondWithError(ctx, rw, http.StatusBadRequest, httputil.Error{
124: 			Code:    http.StatusBadRequest,
125: 			Message: "failed to parse request body",
126: 		})
127: 		return
128: 	}
129: 
130: 	if err := reportData.Validate(); err != nil {
131: 		logger.Warnf("Got error while validating Request Body: %v\n", err)
132: 		httputil.RespondWithError(ctx, rw, http.StatusBadRequest, httputil.Error{
133: 			Code:    http.StatusBadRequest,
134: 			Message: err.Error(),
135: 		})
136: 		return
137: 	}
138: 
139: 	sccs := make([]*nsmodel.SCC, 0, len(reportData.Value))
140: 	externalIDs := make([]string, 0, len(reportData.Value))
141: 	for _, scc := range reportData.Value {
142: 		// New object with the same data is created and added to the sccs slice instead of adding &scc to the slice
143: 		// because otherwise the slice is populated with copies of the last scc`s address
144: 		s := &nsmodel.SCC{
145: 			ExternalSubaccountID: scc.ExternalSubaccountID,
146: 			InternalSubaccountID: scc.InternalSubaccountID,
147: 			LocationID:           scc.LocationID,
148: 			ExposedSystems:       scc.ExposedSystems,
149: 		}
150: 		externalIDs = append(externalIDs, scc.ExternalSubaccountID)
151: 		sccs = append(sccs, s)
152: 	}
153: 
154: 	tenants, err := a.listTenantsByExternalIDs(ctx, externalIDs)
155: 	if err != nil {
156: 		logger.Warnf("Got error while listing subaccounts: %v\n", err)
157: 		httputil.RespondWithError(ctx, rw, http.StatusInternalServerError, httputil.Error{
158: 			Code:    http.StatusInternalServerError,
159: 			Message: "Update failed",
160: 		})
161: 		return
162: 	}
163: 	mapExternalToInternal(ctx, tenants, sccs)
164: 	details := make([]httputil.Detail, 0)
165: 	filteredSccs := filterSccsByInternalID(ctx, sccs, &details)
166: 
167: 	reportHandler(ctx, rw, filteredSccs, &details, reportData)
168: }

170: func (a *Handler) handleDeltaReport(ctx context.Context, rw http.ResponseWriter, filteredSccs []*nsmodel.SCC, details *[]httputil.Detail, _ nsmodel.Report) {
171: 	a.processDelta(ctx, filteredSccs, details)
172: 	if len(*details) == 0 {
173: 		httputils.RespondWithBody(ctx, rw, http.StatusNoContent, struct{}{})
174: 		return
175: 	}
176: 
177: 	httputil.RespondWithError(ctx, rw, http.StatusOK, httputil.DetailedError{
178: 		Code:    http.StatusOK,
179: 		Message: "Update/create failed for some on-premise systems",
180: 		Details: *details,
181: 	})
182: }

184: func (a *Handler) handleFullReport(ctx context.Context, rw http.ResponseWriter, filteredSccs []*nsmodel.SCC, details *[]httputil.Detail, reportData nsmodel.Report) {
185: 	a.processDelta(ctx, filteredSccs, details)
186: 	a.handleUnreachableScc(ctx, reportData)
187: 	httputils.RespondWithBody(ctx, rw, http.StatusNoContent, struct{}{})
188: }
189: func (a *Handler) listTenantsByExternalIDs(ctx context.Context, ids []string) ([]*model.BusinessTenantMapping, error) {
190: 	if len(ids) == 0 {
191: 		return make([]*model.BusinessTenantMapping, 0), nil
192: 	}
193: 
194: 	tx, err := a.transact.Begin()
195: 	if err != nil {
196: 		log.C(ctx).Warn(errors.Wrapf(err, "while openning transaction"))
197: 		return nil, err
198: 	}
199: 	defer a.transact.RollbackUnlessCommitted(ctx, tx)
